hooks.command: STATUS=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\.claude/' | grep -v '^??'); if [ -n "$STATUS" ]; then MSG=$(echo "$STATUS" | head -20 | tr '\n' '|' | sed 's/|/\\n/g'); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"⚠ Uncommitted changes — commit and push before closing:\\n$MSG\"}"; else echo '{"suppressOutput": true}'; fi
